input.query: SELECT substr(signup_date,1,7) AS ym, COUNT(*) AS n, MIN(signup_date) AS min_d, MAX(signup_date) AS max_d FROM customers GROUP BY ym ORDER BY ym

final_answer.basis: 語意層無對應的「新註冊客戶」定義，因此以 customers 資料表的 signup_date 欄位判定註冊日期。統計 signup_date 落在 2025-03-01 至 2025-03-31 的客戶數，customer_id 為主鍵，結果為 150 位。
